notes.title: Ninja Kidz: Time Masters Out Now!
notes.content:
[b]Ninja Kidz Time Masters[/b], the official action-adventure game that features YouTube stars Ninja Kidz TV, is out now worldwide in digital stores for [url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/ninja-kidz-time-masters-switch/][b]Nintendo Switch[/b][/url], [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10007611][b]PlayStation 4 and 5[/b][/url], PC via [b]Steam[/b]. The digital release for Xbox consoles will follow on 20th October. 

With over 20 million subscribers on YouTube, [url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/reO3pHSE0PA]Ninja Kidz TV[/url] is one of the biggest entertainment channels in the world. [i]Ninja Kidz: Time Masters is an action-adventure video game inspired by classic beat 'em-ups. [/i]

[previewyoutube=zT0YoHZHNDs;full][/previewyoutube]

[u]The three greatest martial arts masters have been kidnapped and Dr Disaster and his henchmen have trapped them in different historical eras. The Ninja Kidz are the only ones able to cross the time vortex and use their abilities to rescue them and preserve the path of the ninja.[/u]

[b]Join the Ninja Kidz in their adventure to defeat Dr. Disaster, and bring back peace to the world.[/b] Travel through time and explore different eras by completing fun and challenging 16 levels and watch the story unfold by watching cartoon style cutscenes. Explore all the levels to get extra lives by finding Ninja coins, becoming the ultimate Ninja Kidz, and rescuing all the martial arts masters by defeating the final bosses.

[list]
[*] Choose from 4 playable characters. Each Ninja Kidz has its own special moves and techniques.
[*] Play solo or with friends in local co-op with up to 4 players.
[*] Enjoy the colourful cartoon-style art design inspired by the Ninja Kidz.
[*] Fight multiple enemies and defeat 4 bosses in fun epic battles.
[*] Enjoy 3 game modes and challenge yourself to unlock bonus levels.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2287000/NINJA_KIDZ_TIME_MASTERS/

notes.title: NINJA KIDZ IN STEAM NEXT FEST
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43803124/7426a7dc0b77e280ad0b142bd6a6ba623488747c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Great news for Ninja Kidz fans! [/h2][b]During the Steam Next Fest, taking place from June 19-26, you can enjoy a demo of Ninja Kidz: Time Masters.[/b] Immerse yourself in this exciting 2.5D action game where you will embody the Ninja Kidz to rescue the masters kidnapped by the evil Dr. Disaster in different historical eras. Explore different eras, defeat your enemies and [u]enjoy local co-op mode for up to 4 players[/u]. Don't miss the chance to try this incredible adventure!

Ninja Kidz: Time Masters offers you a colorful artistic design inspired by the Ninja Kidz themselves, with a cartoon style. [b]Choose from 4 playable characters, each with unique special moves and techniques[/b] Face challenging epic battles and defeat bosses. In addition, the game features 3 game modes, including a story mode where you can travel back in time, complete fun levels and unlock extra content.

[previewyoutube=lMK78EkKiBk;full][/previewyoutube]

If you are a Ninja Kidz fan and are excited about Ninja Kidz: Time Masters, don't wait any longer! You can pre-order the physical edition now on [url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BYPYMB7K]Amazon[/url], [url=https://www.gamestop.com/video-games/products/ninja-kidz-through-time---nintendo-switch/392823.html]Gamestop[/url], [url=https://www.target.com/p/ninja-kidz-through-time-nintendo-switch/-/A-88879587#lnk=sametab]Target[/url], [url=https://www.walmart.com/ip/Ninja-Kidz-Through-Time-Nintendo-Switch/2749678823?from=searchResults]Walmart,[/url] [url=https://www.bestbuy.com/site/ninja-kidz-through-time-nintendo-switch/6540355.p?skuId=6540355]Bestbuy [/url]and [url=https://videogamesplus.ca/products/ninja-kidz-time-masters-switch]Videogamesplus[/url], also add it to your wish list on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2287000/NINJA_KIDZ_TIME_MASTERS/]Steam[/url], Nintendo Switch, Xbox and [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10007611]PlayStation[/url]!. Don't miss the opportunity to dive into this exciting adventure full of action and fun. 

[h3]Get ready to save the world together with the Ninja Kidz! The game will be available next September 29th![/h3]
